sn17.4:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruno bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| adhigamāya || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanam paviseyya sā tatra tatra sajjeyya tatra tatra gaṇheyya tatra tatra bajjheyya tatra tatra anayavyasanaṃ āpajjeyya || Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhulābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati || so tatra tatra sajjati tatra tatra gayhati tatra tatra bajjhati tatra tatra anayavyasanam āpajjati || || Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Catutthaṃ || ||
